install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

DOCKER_CHANNEL="${DOCKER_CHANNEL:-stable}"
DOCKER_VERSION="${DOCKER_VERSION:-29.6.2}"
DOCKER_COMPOSE_VERSION="${DOCKER_COMPOSE_VERSION:-v5.3.1}"
BUILDX_VERSION="${BUILDX_VERSION:-v0.35.0}"

if [ -n "${1:-}" ]; then
  DOCKER_VERSION="$1"
fi

echo "==> Installing Docker Client (CLI only) ${DOCKER_VERSION} (channel=${DOCKER_CHANNEL})"
echo "==> Compose ${DOCKER_COMPOSE_VERSION}, buildx ${BUILDX_VERSION}"
echo "==> This package does NOT install dockerd — point DOCKER_HOST at a remote engine if needed."

install_prereqs() {
  echo "==> Installing prerequisites"
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ca-certificates curl wget xz-utils
  elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dnf install -y ca-certificates curl wget xz
  elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl wget xz
  elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pacman -Sy --noconfirm ca-certificates curl wget xz
  else
    echo "WARN: no known package manager; assuming curl/wget already present"
  fi
}

install_prereqs

arch="$(uname -m)"
case "$arch" in
  x86_64)  dockerArch='x86_64'  ; buildx_arch='linux-amd64' ;;
  armhf)   dockerArch='armel'   ; buildx_arch='linux-arm-v6' ;;
  armv7l)  dockerArch='armhf'   ; buildx_arch='linux-arm-v7' ;;
  aarch64) dockerArch='aarch64' ; buildx_arch='linux-arm64' ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: unsupported architecture ($arch)" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

workdir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/docker-client-install.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$workdir"' EXIT
cd "$workdir"

echo "==> Downloading docker-${DOCKER_VERSION} (${dockerArch})"
wget -q --show-progress -O docker.tgz \
  "https://download.docker.com/linux/static/${DOCKER_CHANNEL}/${dockerArch}/docker-${DOCKER_VERSION}.tgz"

echo "==> Extracting CLI binary (docker) only"
mkdir -p extract
tar --extract --file docker.tgz --directory extract
# tarball layout: docker/docker, docker/dockerd, ...
cli_src="$(find extract -type f -name docker ! -name dockerd | head -n1)"
if [ -z "$cli_src" ] || [ ! -f "$cli_src" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: docker CLI binary not found in static archive" >&2
  exit 1
fi
install -m 0755 "$cli_src" /usr/local/bin/docker
rm -f docker.tgz
rm -rf extract

echo "==> Installing docker buildx ${BUILDX_VERSION}"
wget -q --show-progress -O docker-buildx \
  "https://github.com/docker/buildx/releases/download/${BUILDX_VERSION}/buildx-${BUILDX_VERSION}.${buildx_arch}"
mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
chmod +x docker-buildx
mv docker-buildx /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx

echo "==> Installing docker compose ${DOCKER_COMPOSE_VERSION}"
compose_os="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
wget -q --show-progress -O /usr/local/bin/docker-compose \
  "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/${DOCKER_COMPOSE_VERSION}/docker-compose-${compose_os}-${arch}"
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
ln -sfn /usr/local/bin/docker-compose /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose

echo "==> Verifying Docker Client installation"
docker --version
docker buildx version || true
docker-compose version || docker compose version || true
echo "==> Docker Client ${DOCKER_VERSION} installed (CLI + compose + buildx)."
echo "    No local engine started. Set DOCKER_HOST to use a remote Docker Engine."
uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "==> Removing Docker Client (CLI / compose / buildx only)"
echo "==> Leaving dockerd/containerd/systemd units untouched if present."

rm -f /usr/local/bin/docker /usr/local/bin/docker-compose 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx 2>/dev/null || true

echo "==> Docker Client removed"
